source_facts.source: Renewable and low carbon energy PPG
source_facts.fact: Planning guidance distinguishes policy support for renewables from the site-specific planning assessment of solar, wind and battery storage.
source_facts.gate: Policy support is not planning permission.

source_facts.fact: The renewable-energy NPS came into force on 6 January 2026 for nationally significant renewable infrastructure.
source_facts.gate: National need and NPS policy are not a project DCO.

source_facts.fact: The 2025 strategy set actions to increase deployment and reintroduced onshore wind above the relevant threshold into the NSIP regime from the end of 2025.
source_facts.gate: Strategy and threshold do not establish site consent.

source_facts.fact: The 2025 Solar Roadmap set an ambition of 45-47GW by 2030 and more than 70 actions.
source_facts.gate: National deployment ambition is not parcel generation capacity.

source_facts.fact: For lithium-ion BESS of 1MWh or more applicants are encouraged to engage the relevant fire and rescue service before application.
source_facts.gate: Fire-service engagement is not fire approval or planning permission.

source_facts.fact: Recent large solar projects have received individual DCO decisions through the Planning Act process.
source_facts.gate: Another project's consent is not a precedent guaranteeing consent for a parcel.

BESS planning permission is not fire-safety certification

wind speed must not be fabricated without evidence

community benefit proposal is not planning obligation unless secured
